purpose.zh: 练下背、臀部和腿后侧的伸髋力量
purpose.en: Build hip-extension strength in the lower back, glutes, and hamstrings.

text.zh: 以髋为轴下放，起到身体一条直线
text.en: Hinge at the hips to lower, then rise until your body is straight

text.zh: 垫子顶在髋骨下方，脊柱保持中立
text.en: Set the pad just below your hip bones and keep your spine neutral.

text.zh: 顶端停一秒，不再往后仰
text.en: Pause at the top without leaning back further.

commonErrors.en: Swinging up into an overarched lower back.
Rounding the back and lowering too fast.

cautions.zh: 腰部不适时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your lower back feels uncomfortable, and stop if it still hurts.
